tasks.title: Refactor summarize.ts to use buildAgentArgs()
tasks.description:
Refactor `runSummarize()` in `src/commands/summarize.ts` to use `buildAgentArgs('summarizer', 'Technical writer / architecture documenter', projectRoot)` for the agent definition.

Changes:
1. Import `buildAgentArgs` from `../agent-prompt`
2. Delete `buildSummarizePrompt()` (lines 59-120), `buildContext()` (lines 18-25), `buildClaudeMdPruning()` (lines 31-54), and `SummarizePromptOpts` type
3. In `runSummarize()`, build the dynamic context as the user prompt written to stdin. Include: project name, impl file name, whether the impl file already exists, completed tasks path, and CLAUDE.md pruning instructions (with the specific glob pattern from config)
4. The spawn args should use `...buildAgentArgs('summarizer', 'Technical writer / architecture documenter', projectRoot)` instead of `'--append-system-prompt', systemPrompt`
5. Keep the existing `--output-format`, `--verbose`, `--model`, `--dangerously-skip-permissions` flags
6. Update `RunSummarizeOpts` interface to remove fields only needed by deleted functions
tasks.notes: Refactored summarize.ts to use buildAgentArgs(). Deleted buildSummarizePrompt(), buildContext(), buildClaudeMdPruning(), and SummarizePromptOpts. Created buildUserPrompt() that includes project name, impl file, existence check, completed tasks path, and CLAUDE.md pruning instructions. Updated tests to match new exports — old prompt-builder tests replaced with buildUserPrompt tests, runSummarize tests updated to assert --agents/--agent args. Tests require .claude/agents/summarizer.md via makeTempDir(true, true). Task #11 (update summarize tests) may already be covered by this work — verify before starting.

tasks.title: Add installAgents() to init.ts
tasks.description:
Add an `installAgents()` function to `src/commands/init.ts`, mirroring the existing `installSlashCommands()` function (lines 323-341).

1. Create `installAgents(projectRoot: string, ralphRoot?: string): void` — same signature pattern as `installSlashCommands`
2. Resolve ralph root via `ralphRoot ?? resolveRalphRoot()`
3. Build source path: `path.join(root, 'agents')`
4. If source dir doesn't exist, return silently
5. Read all `.md` files from source dir
6. Build dest path: `path.join(projectRoot, '.claude', 'agents')`
7. Create dest dir with `fs.mkdirSync(destDir, { recursive: true })`
8. Copy each file, logging `Installed: .claude/agents/<filename>`
9. Call `installAgents(projectRoot)` from `runInit()`, right after the `installSlashCommands(projectRoot)` call
10. Export `installAgents` for testing

tasks.title: Update init tests to cover agent installation
tasks.description:
Add tests for `installAgents()` in `test/commands/init.test.ts`. Mirror the test patterns used for `installSlashCommands()`.

Test:
1. Copies .md files from ralph's `agents/` dir to `<projectRoot>/.claude/agents/`
2. Creates the destination directory if it doesn't exist
3. Handles missing source directory gracefully (no error, just returns)
4. Handles empty source directory (no .md files) gracefully

Use temp directories for both ralph root and project root, same as existing init tests.
